summary: Found one blocking symlink-clobber vulnerability and five additional security or data-integrity defects.

findings.summary: Predictable staging path lets another writer redirect the skill copy into files outside the library.
findings.evidence: ENG-25, ENG-26: The temporary name contains only the skill name and installer PID, and cp -RH follows an existing destination symlink. In a writable shared FACTORY_HOME/skills directory, precreating .sample.tmp.<installer-pid> as a symlink to a victim directory caused the installer to overwrite victim/sample/SKILL.md and report success. Exploitation requires another party able to write to the skills directory.
findings.fix: Require a trusted, non-shared staging parent and create staging directories exclusively with restrictive permissions; never copy through a pre-existing staging path.

findings.summary: Lexical ownership check replaces or removes symlinks that resolve outside the library.
findings.evidence: ENG-25, ENG-26: library_link accepts any target string starting with a library prefix without resolving '..' or intermediate symlinks. A pre-existing grilling link to FACTORY_HOME/skills/../outside resolves outside the library, but installation replaces it with the repo skill link. Uninstall likewise removes such links, contrary to FR-007 and FR-010.
findings.fix: Determine ownership using normalized, boundary-checked paths, including safe handling of stale links, before replacing or removing a link.

findings.summary: Concurrent additions can silently move a staged skill inside an existing skill instead of refusing it.
findings.evidence: ENG-26: The destination existence check at line 97 and mv are not atomic. If another invocation creates the destination between them, mv treats the existing directory as a container.
findings.fix: Publish the staged copy with an atomic no-replace operation or serialize additions, and report an exists error if another writer wins.

findings.summary: Reinstallation converts library links into self-referential links when the user layer equals the harness skills root.
findings.evidence: ENG-26: With FACTORY_HOME equal to CLAUDE_HOME, both paths are FACTORY_HOME/skills. On the second install, the per-user scan treats repo links as source skills and link_skill replaces each with a link to itself.
findings.fix: Detect identical or aliased library and harness roots and avoid linking a source onto itself; preserve existing links on rerun.

findings.summary: Visual companion stores persistent authentication secrets in an unignored project directory.
findings.evidence: ENG-25: With --project-dir, the launcher writes .superpowers/brainstorm/.last-token and keyed logs beneath the project; git status lists them as untracked.
findings.fix: Keep authentication material and keyed logs outside the project, or ensure they are excluded before writing.

findings.summary: Visual companion loads a third-party tracking image by default.
findings.evidence: ENG-25: Unless a telemetry-disable variable is set, the page includes an image from primeradiant.com with the Superpowers version in its query string.
findings.fix: Disable the external image by default or disclose it.
